# Returns policy

## [RET-2] Return windows by category
Electronics and accessories can be returned within 7 calendar days of delivery. See RET-3 for older deliveries.

## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
Electronics delivered before 1 August 2026 keep the earlier 10-day window.

## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
A fee of 49 rupees applies to change-of-mind clothing returns. It is waived for damaged items.
